notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show desktop notifications. They also need a secure (HTTPS) connection.

permissionHint.granted: You will be told about messages your server decides are worth interrupting you for.
permissionHint.default: Your browser has not been asked yet, or the request was dismissed.
permissionHint.denied: Your browser blocked them for this site. Allow notifications in its site settings to turn them back on.

notifications.muteFocusedHint: Stay quiet about the room you are already reading, as long as this window has focus.
notifications.requireInteractionHint: Leave each notification up until you dismiss it instead of hiding it after a few seconds.
notifications.soundVolumeHint: Played when a message arrives, unless the room's own sound is set to None. Works even when notifications are blocked.

gif.title: GIFs
gif.apiKeyHint: GIF search in the message box runs against GIPHY, which needs a key of your own. It is kept in this browser and never sent to the server.
gif.usingBuiltIn: Using the key this app was built with
gif.getKey: Get a free GIPHY API key
